lead.claim: Targeted brain stimulation improves distal motor control in subacute stroke.
lead.context: Why this matters: This RCT investigated if temporal interference stimulation combined with rehabilitation could enhance upper extremity recovery in subacute stroke.

supporting.claim: Action observation therapy may improve cognition and ADL in dementia.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This systematic review assessed if action observation therapy benefits cognitive function and daily living in patients with cognitive impairment.

supporting.claim: Neuromuscular training might reduce lower-limb injury risk in athletes.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This systematic review examined the effectiveness of neuromuscular training for preventing lower-limb injuries in athletes.

supporting.claim: Prioritize body-weight support to reduce walking energy cost in children with CP.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This study explored factors contributing to elevated walking energy cost in children with cerebral palsy compared to typically developing peers.

supporting.claim: What's the best exercise intensity for knee osteoarthritis?
supporting.context: Why this matters: This trial protocol outlines a study to determine optimal aerobic exercise intensity for knee osteoarthritis and compare training types.
